prompt: Create a stylized watercolor mixed-media editorial portrait of a beautiful young South Asian woman in a close-up 3/4 view, turning her shoulders away while looking back toward the viewer with soft confidence. She has elegant facial features, luminous warm skin, expressive almond-shaped hazel-brown eyes, defined brows, rosy cheeks, glossy coral-pink lips, and long dark flowing hair loosely swept back with wispy strands around the face. Add one ornate gold jhumka-style earring visible on her right ear. Dress her in a flowing light garment or sari-like drape with abstract painterly strokes in navy, cobalt blue, orange, coral, pink, cream, charcoal, and metallic gold. Use high-detail painterly realism with transparent watercolor washes, bold ink sketch lines, dry-brush texture, splattered pigment, drips, layered gouache-like highlights, and expressive mixed-media marks. The composition should be centered on a clean white paper background with loose blue splashes behind the head and coral-orange strokes around the shoulder, leaving airy negative space. Lighting is soft and flattering with luminous highlights on the nose, cheeks, eyes, lips, and hair. Make the mood elegant, romantic, modern editorial, vibrant yet refined. No text, no border, no watermark, no photorealistic background.

promptZh: 创作一张风格化的水彩混合媒介编辑肖像，主角为 一位美丽的南亚年轻女性，采用 3/4 侧面特写视角，她转过肩膀，回眸看向观众，神情柔和而自信。她拥有优雅的五官、明亮温暖的肤色、富有表现力的杏仁状淡褐色眼睛、轮廓分明的眉毛、红润的双颊、光泽的珊瑚粉色嘴唇，以及长而飘逸的深色秀发，发丝随意向后梳理，脸颊旁留有几缕碎发。右耳佩戴一枚精致的金色 jhumka 风格耳环。身着飘逸的浅色服装或类似纱丽的垂坠服饰，并带有抽象的绘画笔触，配色方案为 海军蓝、钴蓝、橙色、珊瑚色、粉色、奶油色、炭灰色和金属金色。采用高细节的绘画写实风格，结合透明水彩渲染、大胆的墨水线条、干画笔纹理、颜料飞溅、滴落效果、层叠的水粉高光以及富有表现力的混合媒介痕迹。构图以干净的白色纸张背景为中心，头部后方有灵动的蓝色溅彩，肩部周围有珊瑚橙色笔触，留出通透的负空间。光线柔和且修饰肤色，鼻尖、脸颊、眼睛、嘴唇和头发上带有明亮的高光。整体氛围优雅、浪漫、现代且具有编辑感，色彩鲜艳而不失精致。无文字、无边框、无水印、无照片级真实背景。
